copy.curiosityHook: Can Greg stage the ultimate deception with substitute parents before his fiancée discovers his old habits never truly stopped?
copy.description: Ready to propose to Flo, Greg faces a crisis: his eccentric parents could derail everything. To protect the wedding, he reopens his alibi agency with old accomplices to hire presentable stand-ins.
copy.vibeSummary: Light, comedic, and easy to follow, delivering steady, accessible farce across a breezy 88-minute runtime.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Philippe Lacheau, this French comedy leans into classic farce, escalating a pre-wedding dilemma into a swift, lighthearted scheme built on elaborate cover-ups.

allowedMaterial: Crooked father and ex-charm actress mother
Scheme to hire fake parents with former accomplices
excludedMaterial: Identity of hired actors beyond the premise
